offeringsSection.updatedText: The menu now shows the chosen options.
offeringsSection.title: What you offer
offeringsSection.text: You can turn each option on or off whenever you like. To turn one off, first sell out the stock of your products or suspend your experiences and accommodation. Bookings already made remain and must be honoured.

deliveryFee.feeHint: Charged once per order. Leave at 0 for free delivery. The platform takes no commission on delivery.
deliveryFee.freeHint: Value of the customer's purchases at your farm. Applies to all your products.

deliveryScope.title: You changed this product's delivery
deliveryScope.question: Do you want to apply the change to this product only or to all products?
deliveryScope.explain: This product only: the default stays the same for the others and for new products. All products: the default is updated and applied to all your products.

stripe.activeText: Your account is ready. You receive the value of each order in your bank account after the customer collects it.
stripe.incompleteText: Stripe still needs some details before it can send you payments. Continue the setup to start selling.
stripe.setupText: Customer payments are processed by Stripe, a secure payment service. Set up your account (identification, tax number and IBAN) to receive the value of your sales.

activity.title: My activity
activity.notYet: Your activity score is calculated every morning. Come back tomorrow to see it.
activity.paused: Paused until {{date}} — your score is frozen and you won't lose your position.
activity.offSeason: None of your products is in season right now — your score is frozen until you have products available again.
activity.max: You're at the top level. Excellent work!
activity.noStreak: No active weeks in a row yet
activity.footer: The most active farmers appear first in the catalogue and are featured on the home page.

lots.failed: The lots could not be recorded
lots.title: Which lot did they come from?
lots.description: The delivery is already confirmed. Indicate which lot the sold units came from; the suggestion is the lot with the nearest expiry date. You can do this later in Orders.
lots.none: This order has no units waiting for a lot.
lots.noLots: This product has no lots with stock.

deliveryMode.label: Delivery method
deliveryMode.notConfigured: You haven't set a delivery area yet. Until you do, customers can't choose home delivery. Set the distance and hours in <link>Availability</link> and the farm's location in the farm details.
deliveryMode.prepDaysHint: The customer can only book delivery from this number of days after purchase, within your delivery hours. Leave at 0 to allow deliveries in the next available slot.
deliveryMode.trackingHint: Tracking is already included in the home delivery price and cannot be charged separately to the customer. You'll need to update the order status (packed, dispatched from the farm, in transit) on the Orders page.

availability.pauseOffText: Your products are back in the catalogue.
availability.badReturnText: Choose a date from tomorrow up to 6 months ahead.
availability.pausedText: Your products don't appear in the catalogue and you don't receive orders. Your activity score is frozen, so you won't lose your position.
availability.pauseQuestion: Going on holiday or between seasons?
availability.pauseExplain: Activate a pause: your products are hidden, you won't receive orders and your activity score is frozen until you return.
availability.pauseNotePlaceholder: E.g. We're between seasons. We'll be back with the first oranges!
availability.badWindowText: The end time must be after the start time.
availability.noRadiusText: Say up to how many kilometres you make home deliveries.
availability.savedText: Customers can now see when you can hand over orders.
availability.title: Availability
availability.description: Enter the days and times when your door is open to hand over orders.
availability.moreTime: The more time you're available, the better your chances of selling.
availability.weeklyHours: You currently have {{hours}}h of open door per week.
availability.notePlaceholder: E.g. Ring the bell at the green gate. Outside these hours, arrange via chat.
availability.homeDeliveryText: Deliveries made by you, by hand, at the customer's address — not shipping by courier.
availability.iDeliverHint: Turn on to set how far and at what times you deliver.
availability.radiusHint: You only deliver to customers within this distance of your farm.
availability.deliveryNotePlaceholder: E.g. Deliveries grouped by area. Arrange the exact address via chat.

productForm.stockHint: Total available for sale in this listing.

productForm.chooseLot: Choose the lot on each sale

productForm.lowStockHint: You get a notification when available units drop to this value (and another when it sells out).

productForm.updatedAll: The delivery was applied to all your products.

productForm.editDescription: Update the item's information and apply discounts.
productForm.stockElsewhere: To add or remove stock, with its expiry date, use <link>My products</link>.
productForm.discountsHint: Put the product on offer. The discount applies to the final customer price.
productForm.deleteText: The product will no longer appear in the catalogue or in your list of published products. This action cannot be undone.

info.errJustificationText: Describe the reason for the changes (at least 20 characters).
info.errDocsText: Attach at least one supporting document.
info.noChangesText: We didn't detect any changes compared with the current details.
info.submittedText: The ValorRural team has up to 7 days to validate it. Your profile will be locked until a decision is made.
info.lockedText: There is a pending change request. Until the ValorRural team validates the information, your profile and products are not shown publicly and you can't make sales. Our team has up to 7 days to complete the review.
info.verifiedText: Your profile is active. Any change to your details must be reviewed by the ValorRural team.
info.pendingRequest: A request is already under review. Wait for the team's decision before submitting a new one.
info.warnIntro: When you submit a change request, your profile will be locked immediately until the ValorRural team validates the new information.
info.warn1: Until it is validated, your profile and products don't appear on the platform.
info.warn2: During that period you won't be able to make sales.
info.warn3: The team has a maximum of 7 days to review the request.
info.warn4: You must attach supporting documents and a clear justification.
info.justificationPlaceholder: Explain the reason for the changes (at least 20 characters)…
info.documentsHint: Attach certificates, proofs or other documents supporting the request.
info.unverifiedText: The ValorRural team is verifying the details you sent. Until approval, your products, experiences and accommodation are not shown to customers and you cannot make sales. You will be notified when your account is verified.
info.unverifiedHint: You can request changes once your account is verified.

status.completeText: To sell, first fill in your farm details. The ValorRural team will then verify them.
status.incomplete: You cannot sell yet: complete your farm details. Until then, feel free to explore the app.
status.unverified: Your details are being verified by the ValorRural team. You can already create products, experiences and accommodation, but customers will only see them once your account is verified.
